description: E19.g G3c-0 prediction of the effect frames the DLL pushes (rule B(k), top-left tie rule). Generated by g3c_model.py from the export only.

frame.note: image = the top-left 320 k x 240 k pixels of the back-buffer (w = 320 k, h = 240 k exactly); camera Zoom = k, Target = (scrollX + 160, -(scrollY + 120)) with integer components; the PS1 point (x, y) is the screen point (k x, k y); the background is posed by the harness

noise_rule: texel within 2^-10 texel of a boundary (exact ties excluded, i.e. kept) or pixel top-left corner within 2^-10 px of an edge or the TR-BL diagonal (exact distance 0 excluded, i.e. kept); exact ties are decided by the top-left rule
tolerance_rule: opaque and background pixels exact; a pixel last written by a blended STP draw (modes Mode0 to Mode2) +-1 per channel

abr_choice.rule: the candidate (378 effect 1 ABR2, 7 effect 1 ABR0) frame with the most blended pixels at k = 1 that differ from the background; 2 to 8 images, >= 2 mirrored
